Your progress

From first lesson to licence, in five steps.

Your instructor sets a steady plan, then builds confidence through practice, a mock test and test day.

01
/ 05
01
Plan it

Tell the planner what you drive and what you know. It tells you hours, price and a realistic test month.

02
First lesson from your door

Your instructor picks you up, sets the seat and mirrors with you, and drives you somewhere quiet.

03
Theory alongside

Practise hazard clips on your phone between lessons. Two coaching calls if you want them.

04
Mock tests on real routes

Two full mock tests with a second instructor. Only when both go well do we book the real one.

05
Test day

Warm-up hour, our car, and a lift home. Most of our learners pass first time.
